name: NetApp ONTAP
description: Shows a NetApp ONTAP cluster (AFF, FAS, ASA, ONTAP Select, Cloud Volumes ONTAP) with its nodes, aggregates and their fill level, volumes and LUNs, disks, the hosts that mount a volume over NFS, and the open health events. Read-only, through the ONTAP REST API (ONTAP 9.8 or newer).
author: Netlens
supports: ONTAP 9.8 and newer (written from the published REST API reference; simulator only, not tested on a real cluster)

releases.changelog: Talks to the device through Netlens' shared HTTP client (certificate and host name checks, timeouts, size limit and redirect rules are the same in every plugin). Needs Netlens 0.4.366 or newer. No change in what the plugin reads or writes.
iSCSI: the hosts logged in to a LUN (sessions and LUN mappings).
First release. Needs Netlens 0.4.178 or newer (kind storage).
